claims.text: Farmhouse Inn is a hideaway in Sonoma's Russian River Valley.

findings.quote: A 25-room hideaway in Sonoma’s Russian River Valley

claims.text: The inn is set on six quiet acres between vineyards, redwoods and the coast.

findings.quote: Set on six quiet acres between vineyards, redwoods, and the coast

claims.text: The inn feels more like a private country home than a hotel.

findings.quote: Farmhouse Inn feels more like a private country home than a hotel

claims.text: Farmhouse Inn was founded in 2001 by brother and sister Joe and Catherine Bartolomei, fifth-generation Sonomans whose family farm is nearby.

findings.quote: It was founded in 2001 by brother and sister Joe and Catherine Bartolomei, fifth-generation Sonomans whose family farm is nearby.

claims.text: The Barn One Bedroom Suite, tucked furthest back on the property, has a separate sitting room and a wide patio warmed by a dual fireplace.

findings.quote: Tucked furthest back on the property, the Barn One Bedroom Suite offers maximum privacy with a separate sitting room and a wide patio warmed by a dual fireplace.

claims.text: Many Wellness Barn treatments spotlight locally grown and sourced ingredients, and the menu includes a CBD and gem stone bathing ritual.

findings.quote: many of the treatments spotlighting locally grown and sourced ingredients. The spa menu includes the expected massages and facials as well as more surprising options, like a CBD and gem stone bathing ritual.

claims.text: Fitness options include a walking path beneath the trees, a Peloton bike and free weights, and private sessions the team can arrange.

findings.quote: hike our path beneath the trees, energize the body with a Peloton Ride and free weights, or let our team help arrange a private session

claims.text: The property has a swimming pool and gardens with roses in late spring and early summer.

findings.quote: a charming little swimming pool, and the most beautiful gardens, especially if you come in late spring or early summer when the roses are going off

claims.text: There is croquet and nightly s'mores.
Armstrong Redwoods State Natural Reserve is about a 10-mile drive from the property.

findings.quote: Armstrong Redwoods, a state natural reserve, with its giant trees and miles of hiking trails is about a 10-mile drive from property.

claims.text: The inn has close relationships with dozens of nearby vineyards, and the concierge can help arrange special tours and tastings.

findings.quote: The Farmhouse Inn has dozens of very close relationships with nearby vineyards and the concierge can help arrange special tours and tastings.

claims.text: Many of the Restaurant's ingredients are grown on the Bartolomei family farm.

findings.quote: hyper local ingredients (many of them grown on the Bartolomei family farm)

claims.text: The Barn Junior Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, an indoor and outdoor fireplace, a steam shower, heated marble floors and a two-person tub.

findings.quote: Floor-to-ceiling windows bring the trees close in our Barn Junior Suite, where an indoor and outdoor fireplace anchors the space from day to night. A spa-style bath adds steam shower, heated marble floors, and a two-person tub.

claims.text: Cottages have private entrances and outdoor seating, plus a gas fireplace, steam shower, heated marble floors and deep soaking tub.

findings.quote: Cottages keep the experience intimate, with private entrances and outdoor seating that makes it easy to slip into the garden air. Inside, a romantic gas fireplace, steam shower, heated marble floors, and deep soaking tub

claims.text: The Wellness Barn spa brings together bodywork, seasonal rituals and thoughtful sourcing.

findings.quote: The Wellness Barn brings together bodywork, seasonal rituals, thoughtful sourcing, and the natural calm of the property

claims.text: The inn can drive guests around Sonoma in one of its fleet of electric Volvos.

findings.quote: We’ll point you toward the version of Sonoma that feels made for you - and even drive you in one of our fleet of electric Volvos.

claims.text: Kitchen waste goes to the hotel's hens, which lay all of the eggs for the property.

findings.quote: kitchen waste goes to hotels 80-some hens, who in turn lay all of the eggs for the property

claims.text: The inn is about 15 minutes from Healdsburg, not in town.

findings.quote: It’s about 15 minutes from both Healdsburg, which is an adorable town

claims.text: The swimming pool is small.
WhataHotel notes the secluded rural setting may require a car for exploring nearby towns and attractions.
